references.text: One of you shall chase a thousand, for the Lord your God is he who fights for you, as he promised you.
The Lord will cause your enemies who rise against you to be defeated before you. They shall come out against you one way and flee before you seven ways.
How could one pursue a thousand and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them and the Lord had given them up?
Joshua encouraged the commanders of Israel's army not to fear, for this is how the Lord would deal with all enemies they fought against.
Gideon's victory over the Midianites, where the enemy fell by the sword, illustrates God's promise of victory over enemies.
Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck down the Philistines, and they fell before them—an example that enemies fall before God's people.
No weapon forged against you shall prosper. A prophetic promise of victory over enemies.
